nodes.label: Blessed Runtime Layer
nodes.rationale: One copy of React, Yjs, @kernel, CodeMirror and remark families stay bare specifiers and resolve through the server's import map at load time. A plugin that bundled its own React would get its own React, and hooks and context would break across the boundary.

nodes.label: Splice Helpers (Metadata Writes)
nodes.rationale: Never rewrite frontmatter or another plugin's %%% section. kernel.documents.splice is the only sanctioned write path for metadata, and it is mandatory discipline, not a convenience.
